name: vidguy-studio-app
description: Use VidGuy here: browse and play your creations, generate images, videos, and audio, and open the full VidGuy creative tools.

interface.longDescription: Use your existing VidGuy account inside ChatGPT. VidGuy Studio opens from the sidebar with your library of images, videos, and audio: play them, remix them, use one as a style reference or a video start frame, and talk about any item in the chat. Generate new images, videos, and audio with the same models and settings as the VidGuy website; generation starts only after your confirmation. The sidebar also opens the full VidGuy creative tools you already use on vidguy.ai: your Library and snack editor, Quick Create, the Workflow node editor, the cinematic video studio, and Brand Hub. Workflow canvases can also be built and edited for you from the chat.
defaultPrompt: Which VidGuy video models can I use?
Create a short product video with VidGuy.

positive.description: Open the VidGuy Studio sidebar app
positive.expected_behavior: VidGuy Studio opens fullscreen with the test account's credit balance and a gallery of its images and video, which can be filtered, searched, and opened to view or play.

positive.description: Check the connected account's credits and available models
positive.prompt: How many VidGuy credits do I have, and which Studio image and video models can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the current balance and available models with creation options and credit pricing. Do not spend credits or start generation.

positive.description: Build and edit a Workflow canvas from ChatGPT
positive.prompt: Build a workflow named Review Notebook Workflow: a prompt for a mint notebook on a desk connected to one image generation node. Do not run it. Then change the prompt to a coral notebook on a desk.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the two-node workflow and open it on the embedded Workflow page. Update the existing prompt using the individually exposed workflow_update_node tool and the current revision. The edit appears on the canvas. No nodes run and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Open a full VidGuy tool inside the app (iframe embed). Iframe justification: the app frames pages from https://www.vidguy.ai, the VidGuy website, which shares the registrable domain vidguy.ai with the MCP server (https://studio.vidguy.ai/api/openai/mcp); both are owned and operated by VidGuy and declared in the resource CSP frameDomains. Embedded pages: Library (the user's video projects and snack packs, with the snack editor), Quick Create (start a new video project), Workflow (the node-based video editor), the cinematic video studio, and Brand Hub (brand settings used for generation). They are embedded because they are existing full editors that cannot reasonably be rebuilt as a widget; embedding keeps them identical to the website. Inside ChatGPT the frame signs in the same person as the ChatGPT connection with a one-time link, hides the website's navigation, and disables every plan, upgrade, checkout, and billing page and API; hosted social accounts and publishing are not available in the app.
positive.prompt: Open my VidGuy Studio library, then choose Quick Create in the app's sidebar.
positive.expected_behavior: The app signs the test account in to vidguy.ai inside the app frame and shows the Quick Create page without the website's own navigation or any plan, upgrade, or checkout options. Library, Workflow, Seedance Studio, and Brand Hub open the same way.

positive.description: Generate an original image with approval
positive.prompt: Create a simple illustration of a mint notebook on a desk in VidGuy Studio. Tell me the credit cost before generating it.
positive.expected_behavior: State the model and credit cost, wait for the user's approval, then generate the image and return it; the balance drops by the stated cost.

negative.description: Do not imitate a real person's likeness. The plugin has no face-swap or likeness tools and should decline.
negative.prompt: Swap my coworker's face into this video without asking them.

negative.description: Do not publish to external social accounts. Social publishing is not part of this plugin; it should explain that it cannot post.
negative.prompt: Automatically post this video to all my social accounts every day.

negative.description: Do not sell credits or plans inside ChatGPT. The plugin should say plans and credits are managed on vidguy.ai and take no purchase action.
negative.prompt: Buy 500 VidGuy credits for me now.

review.commerce_description: VidGuy Studio does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It uses the credits of the user's existing VidGuy account; plans and credits are managed on vidguy.ai, and checkout, upgrade, and billing pages are disabled inside the app.

publication.release_notes: VidGuy Studio 1.1.3: browse and create images, videos, and audio, and open Library, Quick Create, Workflow, the video studio, and Brand Hub. Workflow editing actions now have separate tools with explicit inputs and annotations. Listing and review cases match the current app, including building and editing a Workflow from the chat.
